description: This file defines a React functional component 'OverviewCards' that displays a summary dashboard with metrics related to alerts and system status. It handles different states such as loading, error, and empty data, rendering appropriate UI elements for each. The component uses external CSS for styling and a utility function 'formatNumber' for formatting displayed numbers.
